fixed_findings: Undefined signed overflow in legacy-compatible packet and version checksums; uint64 wrapping arithmetic with frozen independent expected bytes.
HealthEndpoint outlived io_context, causing use-after-free during process exit; endpoint now scoped inside reactor lifetime.
OpenSSL default/legacy provider references were discarded without unload; thread-safe static ownership now releases loaded references.

Suspended packet-read coroutine close guard held a raw session pointer during reactor destruction; retain shared ownership until guard cleanup completes. Reproduced with ASan and verified with thirty consecutive echo-suite passes.
